macro_summary: Markets reopen Tuesday from Labor Day into the most consequential macro week of 2026, with the August CPI print on September 11 and the FOMC rate decision on September 16 sequenced back-to-back. Energy geopolitics add an inflation wrinkle after fresh US-Iran tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend pushed Brent +0.6% pre-market, with WTI near $91/bbl. Tech fundamentals remain strong — AI capex across hyperscalers tracking ~$740B in 2026 — but rate sensitivity keeps mega-cap growth names hostage to the macro binary. Kalshi implies 52.5 percent hike / 46.5 percent hold on Sep 16; August CPI above 0.3 percent priced at 59 percent.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. (NASDAQ ADR)
